findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auth_challenge, whoami, prepare_checkout, get_checkout_intent · Private data: search_products, get_fees, get_prices, get_terms, list_categories, get_category, get_directory, get_deals, auth_challenge, get_delegation, prepare_checkout, create_listing_draft · Public sink: search_products, auth_challenge, list_addresses, get_delegation, prepare_checkout, create_listing_draft, update_listing_draft, prepare_listing_publish.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auth_challenge, whoami, prepare_checkout, get_checkout_intent · Private data: search_products, get_fees, get_prices, get_terms, list_categories, get_category, get_directory, get_deals, auth_challenge, get_delegation, prepare_checkout, create_listing_draft · Public sink: search_products, auth_challenge, list_addresses, get_delegation, prepare_checkout, create_listing_draft, update_listing_draft, prepare_listing_publish

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
